name: Python
summary: Build confidence with core Python, collections, files, JSON, and the standard library.

name: JavaScript
summary: Learn JavaScript syntax, collections, promises, browser APIs, and local Node.js modules.

name: Java
summary: Learn Java program structure, classes, collections, exceptions, streams, and file APIs.

name: TypeScript
summary: Use static types to model JavaScript programs, validate boundaries, and design reusable APIs.

name: C
summary: Learn C syntax, memory, strings, structs, and the standard headers used in everyday programs.

name: C++
summary: Learn modern C++ values, containers, algorithms, references, and resource ownership.

name: Go
summary: Learn Go syntax, slices, interfaces, errors, JSON, and concurrency with the standard library.

name: Rust
summary: Learn Rust expressions, ownership, borrowing, collections, and recoverable errors.

name: SQL (SQLite)
summary: Learn SQL queries, joins, grouping, transactions, and indexes with local SQLite.

name: HTML
summary: Structure accessible pages with semantic elements, links, media, tables, forms, and native controls.

name: CSS
summary: Learn the cascade, box model, flexbox, grid, responsive styles, and accessible UI states.
